statement: {f} (hf : FunCont f) {a b} (hab : a < b) (hfa : f a < 0) (hfb : 0 < f b) : ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f c = 0
name: RealAnalysisGame.IVT
content: The Intermediate Value Theorem (IVT) states that if a function is continuous on a closed interval `[a, b]` and takes values `f(a) < 0` and `0 < f(b)`, then there exists `c ∈ (a, b)` so that `f(c)=0`.
